title: When Safety Rationales Hallucinate: Diagnosing and Grounding Multimodal Safety Guards
abstract: arXiv:2611.25793v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal safety guards increasingly generate rationales alongside safety predictions, yet whether these rationales are reliable remains largely unexplored. We systematically study *rationale hallucination* from two perspectives: visual rationale hallucination, where rationales contain unsupported visual facts, and safety attribution hallucination, where grounded content is assigned an incorrect safety interpretation. Across rationale-generation methods, multiple vision-language backbones, and safety datasets, we find that rationale hallucination is widespread and does not consistently diminish with higher classification accuracy or increased model scale. Further analysis of the Think-with-Image paradigm shows that hallucination is concentrated in fine-grained attributes and relations, while visual tools are often invoked infrequently or without sufficient spatial focus. translated_title: 当安全理据产生幻觉时：多模态安全防护器的诊断与接地
translated_abstract: 多模态安全防护器越来越多地在给出安全预测的同时生成理据，然而这些理据是否可靠在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们从两个视角系统地研究了“理据幻觉”：视觉理据幻觉，即理据中包含缺乏支撑的视觉事实；以及安全归因幻觉，即有据可依的内容被赋予了错误的安全解读。在多种理据生成方法、多个视觉-语言骨干模型和安全数据集上的实验表明，理据幻觉普遍存在，且并不会随着分类准确率的提高或模型规模的增大而一致地减少。对“以图思考”范式的进一步分析显示，幻觉集中在细粒度的属性与关系上，而视觉工具往往被低频调用或缺乏足够的空间聚焦。基于这些发现，我们提出了工具对比接地方法（Tool-Contrastive Grounding Re…，原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次系统揭示了多模态安全防护中的“理据幻觉”现象——幻觉普遍存在且不随分类准确率或模型规模提升而减少，并据此提出工具对比接地方法来诊断与缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically identifies widespread "rationale hallucination" in multimodal safety guards—showing it persists regardless of classification accuracy or model scale—and proposes a Tool-Contrastive Grounding method to diagnose and mitigate it.
